title: Profile questionnaire frontmatter (users/<slug>/interviews/<name>.md)
description: Output of stage 05_interview: a questionnaire the user fills in asynchronously, in their own language. The body is free text; only the frontmatter is validated. A filled questionnaire is extracted by stage 03 like any other document.

language.description: The language the questionnaire is written in: the user's pivot language

status.description: The user sets filled when done

mode.description: full: the whole skeleton · update: only what the profile lacks
